name: dsh-rightbar-diff-split
description: Local persistent Web UI patch: the right panel's 变更审阅 (changes-review) diff opens side-by-side exactly when the panel is fullscreen. State-following, not a hotkey: the plugin subscribes to the live layout store (layoutInfo.rightbarFullscreen), the session-scoped rightbar store (current pane's active tab) and the changes-review view store, and on three events only — a diff tab is opened, the active tab switches to a diff tab, the fullscreen flag flips — it sets that tab's `split` to the current fullscreen value via the same `toggledSplit` action the header button uses (read-then-toggle, so it is idempotent and never fights the user). No polling, no DOM fallback. TypeScript: host half index.ts (type stripping), browser half src/client.ts → lib/client.js (esbuild).
